name: brain
description: Brain - turn Claude into a YouTube learning machine. Capture videos, distill them into an Obsidian knowledge graph, and grow a personal wiki over time.

plugins.name: brain
plugins.description: A complete second-brain workflow for Claude Code. Drop a YouTube URL, Claude downloads/transcribes/summarizes it into your Obsidian vault, growing a semantic knowledge graph. Ships with a worked starter vault (148 anonymized study notes + 17 master wiki pages + a 614-node graph) so the system is useful from day one. Auto-installs yt-dlp, ffmpeg, whisper, and graphify.
